data: In the bottom plot, at a noise ratio of 4%, what is the approximate change in BLEU score for the red line representing the encoder input?

The bottom plot shows the performance of the model when adding noise to different inputs. The red line represents the change in BLEU score for the encoder input. At a noise ratio of 4%, the red line shows a decrease in BLEU score. To estimate the approximate change in BLEU score, we can look at the position of the red line at the 4% mark on the x-axis. The y-axis indicates the change in BLEU score. At approximately 4%, the red line is around -5. This means the approximate change in BLEU score for the red line representing the encoder input at a noise ratio of 4% is -5.
